messages:
Alex Kim: Quick sync — I'm drafting a pinning matrix + docs for model/version deprecation. Need quick decisions on header names, fallback semantics, and rollout notes.
Maria Chen: Do we have a target timeline for unpinning defaults? customers keep asking.
Derek O'Neal: Recommend 6 months for public notice + 30-day forced pin before breaking change. Keeps customers safe and ops predictable.
Lina Patel: Agree on 6 months. Also: pinning should be per-route not global by default. We should support model pin + API version header separately.
Sam Rao: +1. Proposal for headers: `Accept-Version: v1` for contract, and `Model-Pin: model_name@2026-03-01` for model variant. Example curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Accept-Version: v1" -H "Model-Pin: redwood/gpt-ttl:2026-03-01" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`
Maria Chen: That curl looks good. What should be server behavior if Model-Pin is unavailable? fallback to unpinned default? return 409 with hint?
Alex Kim: Two options: 1) soft fallback (serve closest compatible model + warn), 2) strict (error 409 unless fallback policy provided). My preference: default to soft fallback but include `X-Fallback-Model` and `X-Compatibility-Score` headers and a `warnings` field in body.
Derek O'Neal: Soft fallback is practical but we need telemetry to detect regressions. If fallback used, increment `pin_fallback_count` and emit alert on spike.
Lina Patel: Also add response headers for deprecation metadata: `Deprecation-Date`, `Deprecation-Info` (link to migration guide). Make these show up in Console UI.
Sam Rao: I'll draft the RFC with header names, fallback policy, and sample responses. Will include examples for SDK behavior (Node, Python) — e.g., `client.options.modelPin = "redwood/gpt-ttl@2026-03-01"`
Maria Chen: Docs action items: 1) migration guide (Maria) 2) changelog & public notice template (Alex) 3) Console UI: show pinned model per route + deprecation banner (Lina) 4) Telemetry: metrics + alerting (Derek) 5) SDK updates + examples (Sam). Can we set due dates?
Alex Kim: Proposed dates: RFC by EOD Friday (1976600000), Docs + migration guide draft in 2 weeks (1978177600), Console changes in 3 weeks, telemetry in 1 week. Adjust if needed.
Derek O'Neal: Telemetry start ASAP — I'll add a quick dashboard and a weekly query to track `pin_requests`, `pin_fallbacks`, `pinned_client_count`.
Lina Patel: For rollouts, let's support canary policy: `Model-Pin: redwood/gpt-ttl@2026-03-01;policy=canary;percent=10`. Server should accept policy param and route accordingly.
Sam Rao: Nice. Will include canary syntax in RFC and sample server response when canary excludes a request.
DeployBot: Canary deploy of v1 pinning shim to prod succeeded :white_check_mark: (build 2026.03.15-rc4)
Maria Chen: Great — once RFC is up I'll start the migration guide outline. Alex, can you draft the public notice copy?
Alex Kim: Yup. Draft'll include timeline, recommended client changes, sample curl, SDK snippets, and rollback instructions.
Derek O'Neal: One more: add a deprecation-response header `X-Deprecation-Warning` with machine-readable code; helps automation for clients.
Lina Patel: Agreed. And add an API playground badge in the docs that shows pinned vs default outputs side-by-side.
Sam Rao: I'll open the repo PRs after RFC lands. Assigning myself to SDK examples.
Alex Kim: Action items recap (short): RFC (Sam) -> EOD Fri, Docs (Maria) -> 2w, Public notice (Alex) -> draft 3 days, Telemetry (Derek) -> 1w, Console banner (Lina) -> 3w.
Maria Chen: Thanks — ping me when RFC is ready and I'll convert to docs template.
Derek O'Neal: I'll add alerting thresholds to the RFC appendix.
Lina Patel: Thx all. If anyone wants a quick sync I'll be available after stand.
Alex Kim: Thanks — closing the loop here. Will post RFC link when ready.
